# ATLAS AI Coach — atlasfit.pro

ATLAS is an Arabic-first AI bodybuilding coach (web app + Android app) for beginners
in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. It explains fitness and nutrition in simple Egyptian Arabic,
like a human personal trainer.

## What it does
- AI chat coach (Arabic/English) for training and nutrition questions
- Gym programs: 2, 3, 4 and 5-day systems, each with exercise videos
- Home workout program (no equipment)
- Calorie (TDEE) and macro calculator (Mifflin-St Jeor)
- Egyptian and Saudi meal plans in exact grams (koshari, ful, taameya, shakshuka, kabsa)
  with 7 choices per meal
- Progress tracking: weight curve, training streaks, levels, weekly activity

## Pricing (EGP)
- 3-day free trial, no card required
- Monthly 299 / Quarterly 599 / Yearly 2000
- Payment: Instapay or Vodafone Cash

## Key pages
- Home: https://atlasfit.pro/
- Plans: https://atlasfit.pro/pricing
- Sign up: https://atlasfit.pro/auth/signup
- AI chat: https://atlasfit.pro/chat (login required)
- Nutrition: https://atlasfit.pro/nutrition (login required)

## Who it is for
Beginners (0–24 months of training) who want a simple Arabic coach, exact numbers
(grams, sets, reps), and Egyptian food — not generic foreign meal plans.
